text:
Jules H: Postmortem follow-up: vendor dependency mitigations for last week's outage (cloud control-plane + model-registry auth). Need owners, backups, and deadlines. Short thread to assign.

Priya N: I can own cloud-side actions: confirm vendor escalation contacts, request provider logs, and add expected response windows to runbook. ETA 2026-04-07. Backup = Infra on-call.

Marco D: I'll own model-registry work: pin model SHAs, add fallback endpoint, and implement a 1% canary. RFC + test harness by 2026-04-05. Backup = ML infra.

Tess W: I'll take auth-provider hardening: telemetry for refresh failures, retry library with jitter, and evaluate secondary auth fallback. PR + eval by 2026-04-06. Backup = Security on-call.

infra-bot: Created tickets INC-3120 (cloud contacts), INC-3121 (model fallback), INC-3122 (auth telemetry). Owners: Priya N, Marco D, Tess W. Links added to the postmortem doc.

Jules H: Two process asks: 1) weekly quick-check for token refresh + registry health, 2) monthly rotation policy for owners (primary + backup). Can owners confirm?

Priya N: Weekly quick-check: yes, will add a monitor that runs Mondays. Monthly rotation: agree; will set backup and rotation schedule in INC-3120.

Marco D: Canary plan included in RFC. Will add a short checklist for new owners to sign off on rotation.

Tess W: Confirming alerts: refresh failures >0.5% over 5m to pager, auth latency >1s for 2m to Slack. Will open PR for retry lib.

Jules H: Deadlines: Priya 2026-04-07, Marco 2026-04-05, Tess 2026-04-06. Please react :thumbsup: when you accept.

Priya N: Accepted.

Marco D: Accepted.

Tess W: Accepted.

Jules H: I'll schedule a quarterly vendor dependency review to capture recurring patterns; first meeting 2026-04-20 10:00 PDT. Invite to follow.

infra-bot: Calendar event created: Quarterly Vendor Dependency Review 2026-04-20.

Jules H: Closing thread  will update the postmortem with the action table and check back after the first-week sync. If blockers, ping #incidents.
